## Scope

Describe the problem, the affected public contract, and the observable behavior after this change.

## Compatibility and migration

- [ ] Schema or state-contract changes are versioned and documented.
- [ ] Existing projects have a tested migration or remain compatible.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md` and relevant English and Simplified Chinese documentation.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] The full local behavior suite passes.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese flows remain structurally equivalent.
- [ ] Package and previous-version upgrade checks pass when applicable.
- [ ] No generated project output, credentials, personal paths, or private review data are included.

## Review notes

List remaining tradeoffs, known limitations, and any reason an authorized repository-owner bypass is required.
